checks.text: The page shows the heading "Conway Game of Life", the text "Population: 0", and the button "Step" is enabled.

Clicking the cell at row 1, column 1 toggles it to alive; the text "Population: 1" appears. Clicking the cell at row 1, column 2 and the cell at row 1, column 3 toggles them to alive; the text "Population: 3" appears.
With the three cells at row 1, columns 1, 2, and 3 alive, clicking the button "Step" kills all three cells; the text "Population: 0" appears.

Clicking the cell at row 2, column 2, the cell at row 3, column 1, and the cell at row 3, column 2 creates a block; the text "Population: 3" appears. Clicking the button "Step" leaves the block unchanged; the text "Population: 3" remains.

Clicking the cell at row 2, column 2, the cell at row 2, column 3, and the cell at row 3, column 3 creates a diagonal line; the text "Population: 3" appears. Clicking the button "Step" kills all three cells; the text "Population: 0" appears.

Clicking the cell at row 2, column 2, the cell at row 2, column 3, the cell at row 3, column 2, and the cell at row 3, column 3 creates a 2x2 block; the text "Population: 4" appears. Clicking the button "Step" leaves the block unchanged; the text "Population: 4" remains.
Clicking the button "Clear" removes all alive cells; the text "Population: 0" appears.

With the three cells at row 1, columns 1, 2, and 3 alive, clicking the button "Run" starts the simulation; after 100 milliseconds, the text "Population: 0" appears. Clicking the button "Stop" halts the simulation.
Reload keeps the alive cells at row 2, column 2, row 2, column 3, row 3, column 2, and row 3, column 3; the text "Population: 4" appears after reload.
